end_date.description: The end date (optional). Uses the format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss. An example date: 1955-11-05T22:04:00.

single_designation_id.description: The designation. Read-only in the SOAP API.

last_activity_date.description: The last activity date. Uses the format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss. An example date: 1955-11-05T22:04:00.

sponsorship.description: Indicates whether sponsorship. Read-only in the SOAP API.

has_recognition_credit.description: Indicates whether has recognition credit. Read-only in the SOAP API.

schedule_seed_date.description: The next installment date. Uses the format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss. An example date: 1955-11-05T22:04:00.
